storyline.real: Häkkinen leads from pole until a transmission glitch on lap 4 lets Barrichello and Schumacher by. Schumacher leads after Barrichello's lap-27 stop, with Häkkinen held up behind him. Ferrari bring Schumacher in on lap 38; Häkkinen pushes for a few laps, stops on lap 42 and comes out still in front. He wins by 4.9 s.

eras.briefing: Interlagos, 1999. Häkkinen started on pole, but a transmission glitch on lap 4 dropped him behind Barrichello and Schumacher. You run Häkkinen, second after 35 laps and 1.1 s behind Schumacher, both on one stop. Ferrari will pit first: stay out, find the time and win.
